title: Submit the daily report
purpose: Every site's numbers reach the company database by 6:00 PM, so the company report builds itself and nobody chases a message.
with: the Portfolio Manager, who reads it the same evening
when: By 6:00 PM every day, at direct and partner sites.

steps.time: After the end-of-day review, before 6:00 PM
steps.detail: It is the daily report page on the company site. Any phone with internet works.
steps.check: The form is open and shows today's date.

steps.do: Pick your name and your site
steps.detail: The date is today. Direct or partner fills itself in.
steps.check: Name, site, and date are right.

steps.do: Enter the phones and the hours
steps.detail: Phones deployed, phones uploaded, hours recorded, hours uploaded, phones still holding footage. From the device sheet, not memory.
steps.check: Five numbers, each from the sheet.

steps.detail: Wearers scheduled and wearers present, from the wearer log.
Phones down, flags received, incident yes or no with one line, gear needed, anything else.
steps.check: Every field has a number or a word. Zero is a number.

steps.do: Check every number against the sheet, then type the team code and send
steps.check: Every number matches the sheet and the form says sent.

steps.detail: It shows your site, the day, the hours, and the time sent, and it says whether you were on time. A wrong number: press Fix this report, correct it, and send again. The latest send replaces the first.
steps.check: The hours on the screen match the sheet and it says in on time.

done: The confirmation is on the screen before 6:00 PM and the hours match the sheet.

fails.then: Send the report again with the right number. The latest send replaces the first. Nobody edits a report by hand.
Message the numbers to your Portfolio Manager before 6:00 PM. The Portfolio Manager enters them in the form.
The Portfolio Manager sends the report.
The site counts as zero hours for the day. A partner is not paid for a day with no report. At 6:15 PM the site is on the chase list that goes to Mano.

escalate: Your Portfolio Manager, before 6:00 PM, if you cannot send.
